248: Nayuki Minase is Yuichi's cousin, with whom he moves in with at the beginning of the story.
250: Ayu is a rather short, strange, energetic, and a very mysterious girl who literally bumps into Yuuichi early in the story of Kanon. She is easily recognizable by her winged backpack, and her red hairband. Ayu is left handed and loves to eat taiyaki.
316: Yuuichi Aizawa is the main protagonist of Kanon. He is friendly and outgoing, and though as nice as of a person he is, he has yet to learn the sensitivity of women. He constantly teases the main cast of girls throughout the story which varies in severity depending on the girl.
317: Shiori is a first-year student at the same school Yuuichi attends. She also likes ice-cream.
318: Makoto is a character from the Japanese visual novel Kanon. She is a young girl who attacked Yuuichi Aizawa out-of-the-blue in the middle of town early on in the story.
319: Mai Kawasumi, amongst the graduating students of Yuuichi's new high school, is a mysterious girl. Due to her disregard for what's considered "normal behavior", she's viewed as a delinquent by her peers.
320: Akiko is Nayuki Minase's mother and Yuichi Aizawa's aunt whose main role is in Nayuki's arc. Akiko is a kind and caring person. She is a great cook and is proud of her special and unique jam, which no one likes. It's unknown if she has tasted it or if she likes it.
321: Kaori is mainly featured in Shiori's arc. However, as she's Nayuki's best friend as well as Yuuichi's classmate, she's regularly seen. As the class representative, Kaori is smart and very knowledgeable about the townspeople and everyone attending their school.
322: Mishio Amano acts very much like Mai. She too likes to distance herself from others but for a very different reason. At first appearance, Mishio appears to be very cold hearted and stubborn.
333: Sayuri is Mai Kawasumi's only friend before she meets Yuichi, and thus her biggest part is in Mai's story. She is the daughter of a wealthy family, and always tries to smile and help others.
334: The very outgoing Jun Kitagawa is the self proclaimed boyfriend to Kaori Misaka. He worships the ground she walks on, but unfortunately the love is one-sided and is less like two lovers and more like an owner (Kaori) and her dog (Jun).
53091: Kuze is the student council president at Yuuichi Aizawa's school. He tends to be very full of himself and enjoys talking down to people such as Mai Kawasumi due to his standing in the school.
84723: Sayuri's younger brother. He has a shy personality and his body has been weak from an early age.
84759: She was in the hospital for a long time. When Mai was little, she tried to take her to the zoo.
